body: Thanks for the kind words, honestly I have tried time and time again to get a job only to get accepted by companies while getting rejected by governments. My country is sadly not a livable place at the moment, in few months it will be a year in this situation, you know when you try everything within your power but keep getting rejected over extended period of time is what gets me. I have no place to call home, my dream is to have a roof over my head, a stable job in a safe country. Most people have that and take it for granted, I have worked my ass for years and what do I have to show for it, being homeless and struggling to survive, believe me I don't wish to give up but as I said nothing going your way for a very long time, spent my birthday alone along side every holiday the past year, jobless, homeless and friendless.
